title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - PublicService
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/PublicService. A service which is provided by government either directly (through the public sector) or by financing provision of services (definition taken from Wikipedia, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_service). Subclass and specialization of cpsv:PublicService (http://purl.org/vocab/cpsv#PublicService, from the ISA2 Core Public Service Vocabulary), restricted so that cpsv:physicallyAvailableAt only ever points to a s4city:AdministrativeArea and s4city:involvesFacility only ever points to a s4city:Facility.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PublicService'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasName.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasName'. Name of the public service.

hasDescription.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasDescription'. Natural-language description of the public service.

isAvailableInLanguage.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/isAvailableInLanguage'. The dc:LinguisticSystem(s) (language resource URIs, e.g. from the Lexvo linguistic-system vocabulary) the service is available in.

involvesFacility.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/involvesFacility'. The Facility(-ies) the service is provided at.

physicallyAvailableAt.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.org/vocab/cpsv#physicallyAvailableAt'. The AdministrativeArea in which the service is physically available.
